## History

Harmon Andrews was a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose wife was noted by local gossip as never having successfully learned how to manage him.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P6](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0006)_
